quarterly_data.signal: CEO Suresh Venkatesan's AGM update (6-K recap): the production ramp is on schedule and expected to begin in the second half of 2026 with volume shipments of optical engines to customers; POET anticipates expanding capacity to meet demand of up to 1 million units per month by the end of 2027, more than 10x current production capacity, and plans an initial deployment of approximately $50 million for capital equipment in the second half of 2026, while seeking long-term partnerships with key suppliers to secure critical components. The POET Blazar hybrid laser for its external light source product is on schedule for deployment at scale in 2028. More than 10 active customer engagements are expected to exceed $100 million in combined future annual revenue, including the Lumilens agreement, a previously announced production order for 800G optical engines and a significant NRE agreement for External Light Source applications from a new customer.
quarterly_data.figure: volume shipments from 2H 2026; up to 1 million units per month by end of 2027 (more than 10x); ~$50 million capital equipment in 2H 2026; more than 10 engagements expected to exceed $100 million annual revenue
